wrong.why: Mizzah is listed as Reuel's son, while verses 4 and 10 identify Reuel as Bashemath's son, explicitly naming the intervening generation.

missing.why: Adah is explicitly called the daughter of Elon the Hittite.
Bashemath is explicitly called Ishmael's daughter.
Bashemath is explicitly called the sister of Nebajoth.
Bashemath is explicitly identified as Esau's wife.
Aholibamah is explicitly identified as Esau's wife.

note: The Hebrew of GEN 36:26 reads Dishan where the KJV reads Dishon, so I have not imposed a definite namesake correction on those parentage rows. Both timna and timna-3 identify Lotan's sister in the supplied records, so GEN 36:22 alone cannot establish a wrong target between them.
